# /dreamers-implement

Implement a supplied approved proposal or detailed plan. Use meaningful behavior tests and relevant checks; tests-first is optional. Record successful test timings and return outcome coverage, results, and gaps.

Standalone runs create/resume the appropriate feature branch; calls from /dreamers reuse its branch. Verify branch identity before editing.

Stop before review, user testing, commits, or PR creation. /dreamers owns those phases.

See [the workflow](SKILL.md).
